authError.loginWithEmail: Log in with email and password

existingAccount.title: This email already has an account
existingAccount.body: You already created an account with this email using a password, and we couldn't connect Google to it automatically.
steps: Log in with your email and password.
Forgot the password? Contact us and we'll help you get back in.
Once logged in you keep using the same account.

cancelled.title: You cancelled the Google sign-in
cancelled.body: Nothing was changed and no account was created. You can try again whenever you like.
steps: Try Google again and accept the permissions Google shows.
Or log in with your email and password.

expired.title: The sign-in session expired
expired.body: The Google sign-in took too long, was opened in another browser or tab, or was interrupted halfway.
steps: Start the sign-in again from this same browser.
Make sure cookies are enabled and avoid switching tabs or browsers midway.

googleProblem.title: We couldn't use your Google account
googleProblem.body: Google didn't give us a verified email address, or the account couldn't be connected.
steps: Try again with a Google account that has a verified email.
Or sign up with an email and password instead.
If it keeps happening, contact us.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: We couldn't complete your sign-in because of a problem on our side. Your account hasn't been changed.
steps: Try again in a few minutes.
If it keeps happening, contact us and tell us when it happened.
